posts.meta_description:
90K likes, 2,521 comments - therock on October 20, 2026: "Midnight rooftop @teremana toast to the city, I’ll always call my home away from home. Walking the NYC streets at 1am with my dad, the SoulMan 😎 💪🏾 will always be a cool core memory for me when I was a kid. Sounds crazy but it’s how we bonded. All my personal memories when I wrestled in the Mecca - @thegarden. Crowds were electric, rocked with me as a babyface and boo’d the hell outta me as a heel, but eventually, anointed me the People’s Champ. It’s a wild confession here, and a “right of professional wrestling passage” - but what an honor it was to spill my sweat and blood all over the Madison Square Garden. IYKYK

And now, this week we shoot in the NYC streets, and at Coney Island, filming @bowedtie Benny Safdie’s “Lizard Music”. I’ve never shot a film in NYC that I’ve starred in. A first for me and a real honor. Benny is truly New York’s son and it’s been so cool seeing him back home and in his hood, as we shoot our love letter to NYC. 

Here’s to you New York, thank you for the memories, and cheers to making many more! 

🥃 

Now I need a slice 🍕".

The past no longer exists. 
Own it completely, learn from it and move on.

NYC conversations with a friend. 
You might be able to use some of these highlights. 

🥃".

36K likes, 840 comments - therock on October 18, 2026: "Feelin’ good and inspired to work with this beautiful cadre of artists - @kingofbingo @jeffgoldblum @davidkrumholtz & Rachel McAdams. Shakin’ my head with a smile knowing the luminous life they’ll breathe into their roles for Benny Safdie’s ‘Lizard Music’. 

Lizard Music has been an exciting, unique and ambitious swing. Immensely challenging, but a true gift it’s been. Grateful for the role. 

Thank you to our @amazonmgmstudios and producing partners. UA’s Scott Stuber and Nick Nesbitt, David Koplan, Benny Safdie. 

What a cast! Can’t wait for you and your families to experience our film. 

#LizardMusic🦎🎶".

posts.meta_description:
143K likes, 4,117 comments - therock on October 16, 2026: "Another question about fame. 

How has fame changed me? 
It hasn’t. 

I don’t believe fame changes anyone, I believe fame simply magnifies who you are and what you are. Fame will eventually expose what’s inside. 
So be careful if you chase it. 

Here’s a quiet lil’ thing I do, whenever I meet famous people. I always pay sharp attention to how they treat other NON famous people around them. Their teams etc. And especially strangers. Reveals a lot. 

I like our little post workout Rock Talk Q&A’s but geeezus, next time I’ll catch my breath so I don’t sound like I’m trying to inflate a bounce house. 
Wtf 😂".
